verses.en: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongeth to Judah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.
verses.sm: Koliata e Tavita Ua faapotopoto e Filisitia a latou “au e tau. Ua faapotopoto i latou i Suka o i sa Iutā; ua latou to lauapi i le va o Suka ma Aseka i Efesetame.

verses.en: And Saul and the men of Israel were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
verses.sm: Ua faapotopoto foi Saulo ma tagata Isaraelu, ua tolauapi i le vanu o le tapeneto, ua latou tofi ai le taua e o atu e tau ma Filisitia.

verses.en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
verses.sm: Ua tutù mai foi Filisitia i le mauga i le tasi itu, a ua tutu atu Isaraelu i le mauga i le tasi itu, a e ya a“ le vanu.

verses.en: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
verses.sm: Ona alu ane lea o le toa nai le togálauapi a Filisitia, o Koliata lona igoa, mai Kata; o lona maualuga e ono kupita ma le aga e tasi.

verses.en: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
verses.sm: Sa i lona ulu le pulou “apa memea, sa ofu i le ufifatafata faauna o ia; O le mamafa o lona ufifatafata ua lima gaafe o sekeli o “apa memea.

verses.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.
verses.sm: Sa fai foi ufivae “apa memea i ona vae, ma le tao “apa memea i lona vaitau'au.

verses.en: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver's beam; and his spear's head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
verses.sm: O le fuata o lona tao e pei o le laau faalava o lē lalaga ie, o le matatao o lona tao e ono galau sekeli o uamea; ua muamua atu i Ona luma le na ave le tali pupuni.

verses.en: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel, and said unto them, Why are ye come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and ye servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.
verses.sm: Ua tu o ia ma valaau i le itu taua a Isaraelu, ua faapea mai ia te i latou, O le a le mea tou te o mai ai e tou le taua? E le o au ea le Filisitia, a o outou O auauna a Saulo outou? filifili ia e outou se tagata e alu ifo ia te au;

verses.en: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall ye be our servants, and serve us.
verses.sm: afai na te mafaia ona ma tau, ma fasi ia te au, matou te fai ma auauna ia te outou; a e afai ou te malo ia te ia, ma ou fasi ia te ia, ona fai lea o outou ma a matou auauna, e auauna mai ia te i matou.

verses.en: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le Filisitia, O aʻu nei, ou te faamasiasi i le itu taua a Isaraelu i le aso nei; tuu mai ia te au se tagata ma te tau.

verses.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Saulo ma Isaraelu uma i nei upu a le Filisitia, ona matatau ai lea, ma fefefe tele i latou.

verses.en: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.
verses.sm: O Tavita o le atalii ia o le tasi tagata o Efarata, o Peteleema o luta, ua igoa ia Iese, e toavalu ona atalii; na ta‘utoeaina o ia e tagata i ona aso o Saulo.

verses.en: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
verses.sm: O atalii o Iese e toatolu e na matutua ua latou ō ma Saulo i le taua; o igoa nei o ona atalii e toatolu nao ile taua, o Eliapo le ulumatua, o le aupito ane i ai o Apinatapa, o lona toatolu o Sama.

verses.en: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.
verses.sm: O Tavita o le uii ia; a o le toatolu na matutua ua latou mulimuli ia Saulo.

verses.en: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father's sheep at Beth-lehem.
verses.sm: Ua alu Tavita, ua foi atu nai ia Saulo e leoleo mamoe a lona tamā i Peteleema.

verses.en: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
verses.sm: Ua faalatalata mai le Filisitia i le taeao ma le afiafi, ua tu mai i aso e fagafulu.

verses.en: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for thy brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to thy brethren;
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Iese ia Tavita lona atalii, Ina avatu ia i ou uso o lenei efa o saito tunu, ma potoi areto nei e fuagafulu, ma e momo'e atu i ou uso i le togālauapi.

verses.en: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how thy brethren fare, and take their pledge.
verses.sm: Ave foi nei tufaaga a suāsusu maaa e sefulu i le alii o lo latou toaafe, ma ia e asiasi i ou uso po ua manuia, ma ia au mai so latou faamaoni.

verses.en: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
verses.sm: O Saulo, ma i latou, ma tagata Isaraelu uma sa i le vanu o le tapeneto i latou, o loo tau ma Filisitia.

verses.en: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.
verses.sm: Ona tulai lea o Tavita i le taeao, ua tuuina atu ma mamoe i se leoleo, ua ia ave mea, ua alu foi ia pei ona poloai mai o Jese ia te ia; ua oo atu ia i le ‘olo o le a 6 “au i le taua, ua pa le alaga o le a tau.

verses.en: For Israel and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.
verses.sm: Aua na tofi le taua a Isaraelu ma Filisitia, ma ua fesagai itu taua.

verses.en: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.
verses.sm: Ona tuu atu lea e Tavita o mea na ia te ia i le lima o le leoleo i mea, ua momoʻe atu i “au, ua alu ma ofo atu i ona uso.

verses.en: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.
verses.sm: O loo tautala o ia ma i latou, faauta, ua alu ae le toa, o Koliata lona igoa, o le Filisitia, o le Kata, ai “au a Filisitia, ua tautala o ia pei O ana upu na luai fai; ua faalogo ai Tavita.

verses.en: And all the men of Israel, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.
verses.sm: O tagata uma O Isaraelu ua latou vaai atu i le tagata, ona latou sosola lea i ona luma, ma ua latou matua fefefe ai.

verses.en: And the men of Israel said, Have ye seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Israel is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who killeth him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's house free in Israel.
verses.sm: Ua fai ane le tasi tagata o Isaraelu, Ua outou iloa ea lenei tagata ua alu ae? aua ua alu ae ia e faifai ia Isaraelu; o le tagata foi na te fasioti ia te ia, e faatamaoaigaina o ia e le tupu i le oa tele, e avatu foi lona afafine e fai mana avā, e faasaolotoina foi e ia le aiga o lona tama ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that killeth this Philistine, and taketh away the reproach from Israel? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
verses.sm: Ua fesili atu Tavita i tagata na tutu faatasi ma ia, ua faapea, Se a se mea e avatu ma le tagata na te fasia lenei Filisitia, e galo ifo ai le faifai ia Isaraelu? aua po o ai lenei Filisitia 18 peritomeina na te faifai ai i ‘au a le Atua soifua?

verses.en: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.
verses.sm: Ona tali mai lea O le nuu ia te ia e tusa ma ia upu na muamua, ua faapea, E faapea Ona faia i le tagata na te fasi ia te ia.

verses.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab's anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why camest thou down hither? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know thy pride, and the naughtiness of thine heart; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo Eliapo lona uso e matua i lana fesili i tagata, ona tupu ai lea O le ita o Eliapo ia Tavita, ua fai mai foi, Se a le mea ua e sau ai? Ua e tuuina atu foi ia te ai o ná mamoe itiiti ile vao? ua ou iloa lava lou faamaualuga ma le leaga o lou loto, aua o le fia matamata i le taua ua e sau ai.

verses.en: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Tavita, O le a ea le mea ua ou faia nei? Ua fai fua ea lau mea?

verses.en: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.
verses.sm: Ua liliu ese o ia ia te ia, ua faasaga atu i le tasi, ua fai atu foi pei o na upu; ona tali mai lea o le nuu pei o le luai upu.

verses.en: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.
verses.sm: Ua latou faalogologo i upu na fai mai ai Tavita, ona latou ta'uina atu ai lea ia Saulo. Ona aami ai lea o ia ia te ia.

verses.en: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart fail because of him; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai Tavita ia Saulo, Aua neʻi vaivai le loto o se tasi tagata ona O ia; e alu lava lau auauna e tau ma lena Filisitia.

verses.en: And Saul said to David, Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for thou art but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Saulo ia Tavita, E te le lavà ona oulua tau ma lena Filisitia, aua o oe le tama itiiti, a o ia o le toa talu ona tama itiiti.

verses.en: And David said unto Saul, Thy servant kept his father's sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Tavita ia Saulo, Sa leoleo lau auauna i mamoe a lona tama; ona alu atu lea o le leona ma le urosa, ua ave le tama‘i mamoe nai le lafu;

verses.en: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
verses.sm: ona ou tuliloa lea ia te ia, ma ou fasi ia te ia, ma segi mai le mea nai lona gutu; na tu mai o ia ia te au, ona Ou tago ai lea i lana ‘ava, ma fasi ia te ia, ua mate ai.

verses.en: Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God.
verses.sm: Na fasia e lau auauna le leona atoa ma le urosa; e faapea foi lena Filisitia 1e peritomeina, e pei o so laua, ina ua ia faifai i le itu taua a le Atua soifua.

verses.en: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Tavita, o le ALII na ia laveai ia te au nai le lima o le leona ma le lima o le urosa, O ia lava na te laveai ia te au ai le lima o lena Filisitia. Ona fai mai lea o Saulo ia Tavita, Alu ia oe, ia ia te oe foi le ALII.

verses.en: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
verses.sm: Ona faaofu lea e Saulo ia Tavita i Ona ofu, ua faapulouina lona ulu i le pulou “apa memea, ua faaofu foi ia te ia i le ufifatafata uamea.

verses.en: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
verses.sm: Ua fusi e Tavita lana pelu i luga o ona ofu; ona faataitai lea o ia ona alu, aua na ia le masani ai. Ona fai mai lea o Tavita ia Saulo, Ou te le mafai ona alu ma nei mea, aua ou te lei masani ai. Ona tuu ese ai lea e Tavita o mea nai ia te ia.

verses.en: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd's bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.
verses.sm: Ua ia ave lona tootoo i lona lima, ma ua filifili i maa lamolemole e lima mai le alia, ua fafao ai i le ‘ato o le leoleo mamoe sa ia te ia, (o le taga foi lea,) ma le maata i lona lima; ona faalatalata atu lea o ia i le Filisitia.

verses.en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.
verses.sm: Ua sau foi le Filisitia, ua faalatalata mai ia Tavita, ua muamua i ona luma le tagata sa ave lona talipupuni.

verses.en: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
verses.sm: Ua vaavaai mai le Filisitia, ua na iloa atu ia Tavita, ona ‘ino‘ino ai lea ia te ia; aua o le tama itiiti o ia, ua enaenamúmú lona lauulu, ua manaia foi ona mata.

verses.en: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai le Filisitia ia Tavita, Ou te se uli ea au, ina ua e sau ia te au ma tootoo? Ona fetuu lea le Filisitia ia Tavita i ona atua.

verses.en: And the Philistine said to David, Come to me, and I will give thy flesh unto the fowls of the air, and to the beasts of the field.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai foi le Filisitia ia Tavita, Sau ia ia te au, ou te foai atu ai lou tino i manu felelei ma manu tataa.

verses.en: Then said David to the Philistine, Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the LORD of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu lea o Tavita i le Filisitia, Ua e sau ia te au ma le pelu, ma le tao, ma le tao leoleo; a o aʻu, ou te alu atu ia te oe i le suafa o le ALII o “au, o le Atua o le itu taua a Isaraelu ua e faifai i ai.

verses.en: This day will the LORD deliver thee into mine hand; and I will smite thee, and take thine head from thee; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air, and to the wild beasts of the earth; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel.
verses.sm: O le aso nei e tuuina mai ai oe e le ALII i loʻu lima, ou te fasi ia te oe, ma ave ese lou ulu; ou te foai atu foi tino oti o ‘au a Filisitia i lenei aso i manu felelei ma manu feai e tataa; e iloa ai e le lalolagi uma, o i ai le Atua ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.
verses.sm: E iloa ai foi e lenei faapotopotoga uma, e le faaolaina tagata e le ALII i se pelu ma se tao; aua O loo i le ALt le taua, na te tuuina mai outou i o matou lima.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the Philistine arose, and came and drew nigh to meet David, that David hasted, and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.
verses.sm: Ua tulai le Filisitia, ua alu ane, ma faalatalata e faafetaiai ia Tavita; ona faataalise lea o Tavita, ua momo'e atu i le itu tauā e faafetaiai i le Filisitia.

verses.en: And David put his hand in his bag, and took thence a stone, and slang it, and smote the Philistine in his forehead, that the stone sunk into his forehead; and he fell upon his face to the earth.
verses.sm: Ona tago ifo lea o Tavita i le “ato, ua avae ai se maa, ua sasau E ia le maata, ua lavea le Filisitia i lona muaulu, ua goto le maa i lona muaulu, ona pau fad ai lea o ia i le eleele.

verses.en: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.
verses.sm: so Ua malo Tavita i le Filisitia i le maatā ma le maa; ua na fasi le Filisitia, ua oti ai, a e leai se pelu i le lima o Tavita; SI ona momo'e atu ai lea Tavita,

verses.en: Therefore David ran, and stood upon the Philistine, and took his sword, and drew it out of the sheath thereof, and slew him, and cut off his head therewith. And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead, they fled.
verses.sm: ua tu i luga o le Filisitia, ua tago i lana pelu, ua to ae nai lona faamoega, ua na faaoti ai ia te ia, ma vavae ai lona ulu. Ua vaai Filisitia ua oti lo latou toa, ona sosola ai lea o i latou.

verses.en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose, and shouted, and pursued the Philistines, until thou come to the valley, and to the gates of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim, even unto Gath, and unto Ekron.
verses.sm: Ona tutii lea o tagata o Isaraelu ma Iuta, ua sólovi, ma tuliloa ia Filisitia e oo atu i le vanu, ua oo foi i puipui o Ekerona. Ua pauu e na manunua o Filisitia i le ala o Saraima, ua oo i Kata, na oo foi i Ekerona.

verses.en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines, and they spoiled their tents.
verses.sm: Ua foi atu le fanauga a Isaraelu sa tulitatao ia Filisitia, ona latou vetea lea o latou togalauapi.

verses.en: And David took the head of the Philistine, and brought it to Jerusalem; but he put his armour in his tent.
verses.sm: Ua ave e Tavita le ulu o le Filisitia, ua au mai i Ierusalema, a O ana mea ua tuu e ia i lona fale ie.

verses.en: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine, he said unto Abner, the captain of the host, Abner, whose son is this youth? And Abner said, As thy soul liveth, O king, I cannot tell.
verses.sm: Na vaai Saulo ia Tavita ina ua alu atu e faafetaiai i le Filisitia, ona fai atu ai lea o ia ia Apineru le pule i ‘au. Apineru e, se atalii o ai lena tama? Ua fai mai Apineru, Ua e soifua, le tupu e, ou te le iloa lava.

verses.en: And the king said, Enquire thou whose son the stripling is.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o le tupu, Ia e fesili, pe se atalii o ai lena taulealea?

verses.en: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, Abner took him, and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
verses.sm: O loo foi Tavita nai le fasiga o le Filisitia, ona ave lea o ia e Apineru, ua momoli ia te ia i luma o Saulo, o le ulu foi o le Filisitia ua i lona lima.

verses.en: And Saul said to him, Whose son art thou, thou young man? And David answered, I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth-lehemite.
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea o Saulo ia te ia, Le atalii ea oe o ai, sé? Ua fai atu Tavita, O afu le atalii o lau auauna o lese le Peteleema. Ua alofagia
